cards.title: Earring with Four-Armed Vishnu Riding Garuda with Nagas (serpent divinities)
cards.extract: In Nepal, sculptures of deities were adorned with jewelry larger than pieces made for human beings. This pair of earrings features the Hindu god Vishnu seated cross-legged riding his mount the man-eagle Garuda. Garuda's arms are outstretched, grabbing the tails of serpents whose braided bodies snake up both sides of each earring. His wings drape like a cape behind him, and his talons clutch his crescent moon perch. Serpent hoods rise up behind Vishnu like a canopy.

cards.title: Plaza Pochote Commercial Center / FAMM Arquitectura
cards.extract: Plaza Pochote is a commercial development designed by FAMM Arquitectura in Santa Teresa , Costa Rica. Located along the town's main road, the project responds to a predominantly linear pattern of roadside development and the limited availability of public space within a rapidly growing coastal context.
